title: Research brief: 20 public datasets on EV charging in Europe
description:
Find 20 public datasets about EV charging stations in Europe. For each one give the name, publisher, licence, update frequency, a link and a two-line summary. Deliver one Markdown table and the same rows as a CSV.

## What counts

- Open data portals of the EU, national governments and cities
- Operator APIs with a published licence
- No scraped mirrors

## Format

| name | publisher | licence | updated | link | summary |

A CSV with the same columns, UTF-8, comma-separated.
